cost.details: Reaction: when you take magical damage

description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

Reaction (1 scrap): When you take magical damage, regain 2 Toolbelt scraps.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): Reduce the incoming damage by half.

Passive: +2 Toolbelt scraps to your maximum.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] Regains 2 Toolbelt scraps (net +1 after the 1-scrap activation).

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Ether Capacitator (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Ether Capacitator" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.
